data.narrative:
Thea Energy is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Brian Berzin that has raised $20M to date. The valuation universe consists of 11 comparable companies across the nuclear energy sector: 3 publicly traded (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using total capital raised ($20M) as a proxy baseline of $100M in effective valuation inputs, a typical Series B to subsequent-stage multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $190M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while six same-sector peers exist, fewer than three companies aligned on both stage and valuation tier, making sector-wide medians unreliable for precision valuation.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to the single robust methodology, supports a valuation range of $162M to $218M, with a median of $190M. The range reflects uncertainty bands around the stage-progression step-up multiplier rather than cross-method divergence. Key uncertainties include the appropriate step-up multiple for this company's specific Series B-to-C trajectory, technology maturity relative to the peer set, and capital efficiency versus other nuclear energy developers. Tighter valuation precision would require either additional comparable transactions or detailed fundamental modeling.
